title: Bench decision event payload (W10)
description: The head of training's decision on a bench review, with the hash of the evidence pack it rested on. The rationale is required and stays in the private store under rationale_key; the event holds references and a hash only (decisions 0003 and 0005). return-to-co-teaching is the default for a teaching-quality reason.

decided_by.description: The head of training: a people-list person, or the instructor a mapped person signs as (decision 0012)
